name: CRR_USRenal_Adult
title: US Renal - Adult
publisher: Health New Zealand | Te Whatu Ora - Community Referred Radiology Programme
description: Published structure and wording of the US Renal (Adult) national referral criteria (pp.52-55), with each criterion bound to a named expression in the CQL library CRR_USRenal_Adult. NOT CLINICALLY REVIEWED (W1 demo transcription, AD-35). This resource carries what the Criteria Viewer renders; the Library carries the logic; the Questionnaire carries the input contract. The acute-assessment row and the renal colic red-flag footnote are shown here for the referrer but are evaluated by the national red-flag bundle (RF-12, RF-03).

action.title: Consider admission or seek advice for Pyelonephritis where presentation with fever (higher than 38 degrees), pyuria on microscopy, loin pain or tenderness, +/- lower UTI symptoms and:
not responding to antibiotics after 72 hours and abscess development is a consideration, or
flank pain that does not improve within 24 hours of IV or 48 hours of oral antibiotics

documentation.display: *1 Red flags for renal colic: Creatinine > 160 micromol/L or eGFR < 45 mL/min; solitary kidney; temperature > 38 degrees; peritonitis; signs of sepsis; known bilateral ureteric stones
